name: dex-momentum-bot
description: Momentum trading bot for Jupiter (Solana), PancakeSwap (BSC), BaseSwap (Base)

scripts.paper: cross-env BOT_PROFILE=paper PAPER_TRADING=true SQL_ENABLED=false SQL_STATE_RESTORE_ENABLED=false PORT=3001 PYTHON_SIDECAR_MAX_CONCURRENT=1 PYTHON_SIDECAR_MAX_QUEUE=10 node src/index.js
scripts.test:v2-smoke: node --test test/core-contracts.test.js test/dashboard-v2-report.test.js test/dashboard-trade-history.test.js test/v2-ci-workflow.test.js test/strategy-routing-audit.test.js test/sql-telemetry-regression.test.js test/stats/metrics-compute.test.js test/cycle/maintenance.test.js test/self-evolution-regressions.test.js test/risk/v2-risk-audit.test.js test/execution/bsc-flow-sizing.test.js
scripts.pm2:start: node -e "console.error('PM2 is disabled for this bot. Use the desktop Start Both Bots.bat launcher.'); process.exit(1)"
